integrity: All statements and computations concern the original digit-sum language; independent scientific validation is not claimed. Attached standalone checker tests finite parameter sets only, and the analytic proof covers the unbounded family.
scientific_limitations: Modulus m=2 and alphabet-changing antimorphisms excluded; for lengths at least three the answer is expressed in terms of the separately known ordinary factor complexity. Search cannot rule out inaccessible or unindexed equivalent literature.
title: Sharp reversal-freeness and reflection complexity of generalized Thue–Morse words
